key_decisions.rationale: Retains the source's gendered insult as ancient rhetoric and the athletic command.
key_decisions.before: Reject godless myths fit for old wives. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
key_decisions.after: Reject profane tales fit for old women, and train yourself in godliness.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But reject irreverent myths and old-woman tales; rather train yourself for godliness,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves strenuous work and the difficult all/especially relation.
key_decisions.before: For this reason we labor and struggle, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is Savior of all people, especially of those who trust.
key_decisions.after: For this we labor and struggle, because we have put our hope in the living God, who is Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For to this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the striking salvation language tied to sustained life and teaching.
key_decisions.before: Pay close attention to yourself and to the teaching. Continue in these things, because by doing so you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
key_decisions.after: Pay close attention to yourself and to the teaching. Persevere in them, for by doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
